title: Text Formatting and Typography
description: Learn about text formatting tags like bold, italic, underline, superscript, subscript, and quotes in HTML.

quiz.question: Which tag is used to make text bold in HTML?
quiz.explanation: The `<b>` tag makes text bold without implying extra importance.

quiz.question: What is the difference between <b> and <strong> tags?
quiz.explanation: `<b>` simply styles text bold; `<strong>` also semantically means strong importance.

quiz.question: Which tag italicizes text?
quiz.explanation: The `<i>` tag italicizes text without extra emphasis.

quiz.question: Which tag is used for emphasized text that is usually italicized?
quiz.explanation: The `<em>` tag indicates emphasis, typically rendered in italics.

quiz.question: How do you underline text in HTML?
Which tag is used for superscript text?
quiz.explanation: The `<sup>` tag makes text appear as superscript.

quiz.question: Which tag is used for subscript text?
quiz.explanation: The `<sub>` tag makes text appear as subscript.

quiz.question: How do you insert a block quotation in HTML?
quiz.explanation: The `<blockquote>` tag is used for long quotations.

quiz.question: Which tag is used for short inline quotations?
quiz.explanation: The `<q>` tag is used for inline quotes and usually adds quotation marks automatically.

quiz.question: Which tag is used to cite a source or reference?
quiz.explanation: The `<cite>` tag is used to reference a source.
